citations.line: The accident investigation into CAPA-2005-001 recommended that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment be strengthened in this standard.
The accident investigation into NM-2005-0006 recommended that the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment be strengthened in this standard.
The engineering change note record for this revision cites NM-2005-0006 as the reason the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was amended.
A regulatory requirement arising from CAPA-2005-001 obliges this standard to carry the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment.
Revision 1 was raised in response to NM-2005-0006, and the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was amended as a result.

response.reason: Scheduled review at revision 1; 17 clauses restated.
